body.statement: For absolute constants \(0<c<C<\infty\), \(c\min\{1,K\log(eK)/n\}\le R(n,1,K)\le C\min\{1,K\log(eK)/n\}\) for every \(n\ge1\) and \(K\ge2\); this adds the global bounded-Bernoulli all-estimator converse absent from the instance-dependent upper-bound theory of Nguyen, Barrett, and Jun, while leaving their easy-instance guarantees intact.
body.justification: The passive one-group slice fixes the unavoidable \(\log K\) factor and prevents importing adaptive best-arm sample complexity.
body.gap: NguyenBarrettJun2025HAVER proves sharp instance-dependent MSE upper bounds but no matching global minimax lower bound over bounded Bernoulli means.
body.consumer: Maximum-mean estimation in Q-learning and Monte Carlo tree search gains a finite-sample worst-case benchmark for passive data.
